ruleset.name: apex-jwe
ruleset.description:
Complexity rules with thresholds this library can be held to.
The class level totals are raised because the design of this library is deliberately many small types with many small methods: JweBytes alone exposes twenty operations, each of which validates its arguments, and the total says nothing about any of them. The method level limits are what actually guard against a method growing a shape a reader cannot follow, and those stay close to the defaults.
